sec.title: August 27 Archival Enrichment (Increment 214)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 27** across American network radio, Admiral Richmond Kelly Turner's eyewitness account of the Battle of Okinawa and the Allied victory fleet on CBS, William Conrad and Howard McNear in John Meston's classic *Gunsmoke* script "Doc Quits" for L&M, Hugh Marlowe as *Ellery Queen* for Gulf Oil, Paul Whiteman on *The Philco Radio Hall of Fame*, Dana Andrews in *I Was a Communist For The FBI*, and Arnold Marquis's geopolitical documentary *The Pacific Story* (1939–1955):
